_note: v1 (owner's pick, 2026-11-14): DRY. The recordings are only trimmed of silence and peak-normalised; 'chain' is a no-op and noise is 0. The raspy first guess is kept in _raspy_chain_unused (put it back in 'chain' and set params.noise to 0.012 to use it); eight tried variants are in assets-private/audio/thieves/voice-variants/. The thieves' voice chain (a raspy 'heavy smoker' voice), read only by the offline bake scripts/make_thief_voices.py. Each 'chain' entry is one ffmpeg filter, in order, with {name} replaced by the literal text of params[name] (numbers keep the spelling written here). The dry recording is first trimmed of silence and peak-normalised to dry_peak_db (so gain_db drives every line into the clipper alike), then runs through 'chain'; 'noise_chain' shapes a pink-noise bed (the breath) that is mixed under the result at params.noise (linear, 0 = none); the bake peak-normalises the sum to out_peak_db (the vorbis encode overshoots it by up to ~1 dB, so -2 keeps the ogg under 0). Edit the values or the order here, nowhere else. First guess, tune by ear: pitch (1 = unchanged, lower = deeper), rough_hz/rough_depth (fast tremolo: the crackle of a ruined voice), gain_db/clip (grit), low/high (band limit), noise (breath).
